sourceChecks.text: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that the LORD spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

sourceChecks.text: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

sourceChecks.text: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

sourceChecks.text: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でこの人物/集団が明示され、該当する用例として採用。

sourceChecks.text: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

sourceChecks.text: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

sourceChecks.text: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

sourceChecks.text: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
